kettering-town.summary: Kettering were the first English club to wear sponsorship on their shirts in 1976, and have scored more goals in the FA Cup than any other club.

alvechurch.summary: Alvechurch Football Club is a football club based in Alvechurch, Worcestershire, England. They are currently members of the Southern League Premier Division Central and play at Lye Meadow.

anstey-nomads.summary: Anstey Nomads Football Club is a football club based in Anstey, Leicestershire, England. They are currently members of the Southern League Premier Division Central and play at Cropston Road.

banbury-united.summary: Banbury United Football Club is a football club based in Banbury, Oxfordshire, England. They are currently members of the Southern League Premier Division Central and play at the Spencer Stadium.

bishops-stortford.summary: Bishop's Stortford Football Club is a football club based in Bishop's Stortford, Hertfordshire, England. They are currently members of the Southern League Premier Division Central and play at Woodside Park.

bromsgrove-sporting.summary: The club was founded in 2009 and played their first season, 2010–11, in Midland Football Combination Division Two, where they ended third.

bury-town.summary: Bury Town Football Club is a semi-professional football club, based in Bury St Edmunds, Suffolk, England.

halesowen-town.summary: Halesowen Town Football Club is a football club based in Halesowen, West Midlands, England. They are currently members of the Southern League Premier Division Central and play at the Grove Recreation Ground.

hitchin-town.summary: Founded in 1865 and known as 'The Canaries', Hitchin Town have been based at Top Field since their foundation, and claim lineage from the defunct Hitchin Football Club, formed in 1865 and liquidated in 1911. The club have played in a number of local leagues, starting off in the Spartan League before moving to first the Athenian League in 1939, then the Isthmian League in 1963 and finally the Southern League in 2004. Their most recent league honour has been the Southern League Division One Central, finishing play-off winners in 2010–11, their second season in the competition.

leamington.summary: Leamington Football Club is a football club based in Leamington Spa, Warwickshire, England. They are currently members of the Southern League Premier Division Central and play at the New Windmill Ground near Bishop's Tachbrook.

leighton-town.summary: Leighton Town Football Club are an English football club located in Leighton Buzzard, Bedfordshire. They were established in 1885. The club plays home games at Bell Close and currently play in the Southern League Premier Division Central.

leiston.summary: Leiston Football Club is a football club based in Leiston, Suffolk, England. They are currently members of the Southern League Premier Division Central and play at Victory Road.

needham-market.summary: Needham Market Football Club is a football club based in Needham Market, Suffolk, England. They are currently members of the Southern League Premier Division Central and play at Bloomfields.

peterborough-sports.summary: Peterborough Sports Football Club is an English football club based in Peterborough, Cambridgeshire, England. The club are currently members of the Southern League Premier Division Central and play at Lincoln Road.

racing-club-warwick.summary: Racing Club Warwick Football Club is a football club based in Warwick, Warwickshire, and competes in the Southern League Premier Division Central.

real-bedford.summary: Real Bedford Football Club is a football club in Bedford, England, established in 2002 as a merger of Bedford United and US Valerio. They are members of the Southern League Premier Division Central, the seventh tier of the English football system, and play at McMullen Park.

redditch-united.summary: The club participates in the Southern League Premier Division Central and play their home games at the Valley Stadium.

rushall-olympic.summary: The team competes in the Southern League Premier Division Central, the seventh tier of the English football league system.

stamford.summary: They currently compete in the Southern League Premier Division Central.

stourbridge.summary: Stourbridge Football Club (nicknamed "The Glassboys" due to the town's traditional association with the cut glass industry) is an English association football club based in the town of Stourbridge, West Midlands.

stratford-town.summary: Stratford Town Football Club is a football club representing the town of Stratford upon Avon, Warwickshire, England, but currently based in nearby Tiddington. They are currently members of the Southern League Premier Division Central and play at Knights Lane.

worcester-city.summary: Established in 1902, the club play at Sixways Stadium. Worcester City's most notable successes include an FA Cup first round victory against Coventry City and a third round win, in the same competition, against Liverpool.
